title: Graph Forecasts for Time Series
text: grafts explores time series stored tsibble whose keys aggregated aggregate_key(). structure keys works, whether hierarchical (State / Region), grouped (Purpose * State) mix . graph_explore() opens explorer browser. data stays R, serves series drawn, large collections series open quickly. app runs background stopped : also explore forecasts, pass fable forecasts series forecasts. model’s forecasts intervals drawn data.
code: library(grafts) library(fable)  tourism_agg <- aggregate_key(   tsibble::tourism, Purpose * (State / Region), Trips = sum(Trips) ) app <- graph_explore(tourism_agg) plumber2::api_stop(app) tourism_fc <- tourism_agg |>   model(ets = ETS(Trips), snaive = SNAIVE(Trips)) |>   forecast(h = "2 years") app <- graph_explore(tourism_agg, forecasts = tourism_fc)

title: Explore an aggregated tsibble through its series and dimension graphs — graph_explore
Explore an aggregated tsibble through its series and dimension graphs — graph_explore
code: if (interactive()) {   library(fable)   tourism_agg <- aggregate_key(     tsibble::tourism, Purpose * (State / Region), Trips = sum(Trips)   )    # The structure is inferred from the keys: Purpose * (State / Region)   app <- graph_explore(tourism_agg)   plumber2::api_stop(app)    # With forecasts, drawn after the data with their intervals   tourism_fit <- model(tourism_agg, ets = ETS(Trips), snaive = SNAIVE(Trips))   tourism_fc <- forecast(tourism_fit, h = "2 years")   app <- graph_explore(tourism_agg, forecasts = tourism_fc)   plumber2::api_stop(app) }
